source_refs.note: Exercise 3.3, Question 22: book p. 89-90, 24 questions (integration by parts); answer key p. 301 (printed under 'Exercise 3.5')

blocks.explanation:
Agar \(x^5e^{5x}\) ko seedha parts se karein to paanch dafa parts lagana parega! Is liye pehle koi shortcut dhoondhte hain.
Kitab ka Note: \(\int e^{g}[fg' + f']\,dx = e^{g}f + c\). Yahan \(g = 5x\), \(g' = 5\), to chahiye \(5f + f' = x^5 + x^4 + 1\).
\(f = \frac{x^5 + 1}{5}\) lein: \(5f = x^5 + 1\) aur \(f' = x^4\). Bilkul fit!
Plan: integral ko torein, \((x^5 + 1)\) ko first function bana kar parts lagayein; bacha hua \(\int x^4e^{5x}\,dx\) cancel ho jayega.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int e^{5x}(x^5 + x^4 + 1)\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: torenge; \(\int (x^5 + 1)e^{5x}\,dx\) par parts, \(x^5 + 1\) first aur \(e^{5x}\) second; \(\int x^4e^{5x}\,dx\) cancel ho jayega.

Torein
\[= \int (x^5 + 1)e^{5x}\,dx + \int x^4e^{5x}\,dx\]
Kyun: \(x^5 + 1\) ko ikattha rakha, kyunke us ka derivative \(5x^4\) hai, jo doosre hisse se mel khata hai.

Pehle integral par parts
\[\int (x^5 + 1)e^{5x}\,dx = (x^5 + 1)\dfrac{e^{5x}}{5} - \int \dfrac{e^{5x}}{5}\cdot 5x^4\,dx\]
\[= \dfrac{(x^5 + 1)e^{5x}}{5} - \int x^4e^{5x}\,dx\]
Kyun: \(e^{5x}\) ka integral \(\frac{e^{5x}}{5}\), \((x^5 + 1)\) ka derivative \(5x^4\); 5 aur \(\frac{1}{5}\) cancel.

Cancel karein
\[= \dfrac{(x^5 + 1)e^{5x}}{5} - \int x^4e^{5x}\,dx + \int x^4e^{5x}\,dx\]
\[= \dfrac{e^{5x}}{5}(x^5 + 1) + c\]
Kyun: \(\int x^4e^{5x}\,dx\) ek dafa minus, ek dafa plus; dono khatam.
Dhyan dein: answer key ka \(\frac{e^{5x}}{5}(x^5 + 1)\) aur yeh ek hi cheez hai; \(+1\) ko bhoolna nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left[\dfrac{e^{5x}}{5}(x^5 + 1)\right] = e^{5x}(x^5 + 1) + \dfrac{e^{5x}}{5}\cdot 5x^4\]
\[= e^{5x}(x^5 + x^4 + 1)\]
Kyun: product rule; integrand wapas aaya.
